general_finding_join_method.claim: Every theme_graph company node (co:us:*, and co:cn/hk/ca/intl:*) is minted directly from a bare ticker string; external_ids is always exactly {'symbol': <ticker>} with no CIK, no company_id, no security_id distinct from the ticker.
general_finding_join_method.consequence: join_method=ticker_string for the ENTIRE theme_graph company plane; confidence=degraded for every membership claim sourced from theme_graph (canonical_theme_crosswalk, curated_baskets, finviz_ltheme, ths_ltheme all inherit this).

hostile_cases_found.finding: REVISED (adversarial review H2): data/baskets/membership.json (the LIVE curated-basket source of truth) is ALREADY CORRECT -- gold_miners has 12 members, does NOT include GOLD, and its 'omitted' list explicitly documents the wrong-issuer repair (PR #5632): 'GOLD (Gold.com/A-Mark bullion dealer, EDGAR CIK 1591588 -- not a miner; its store tape was NEVER Barrick; Barrick Mining is NYSE B, EDGAR CIK 756894)'. The STALE carriers, verified directly: (1) data/baskets/membership_history.parquet's 2026-08-13 snapshot_date rows still show GOLD present (added=2023-05-09, removed=NaN) with NO 'B' row for gold_miners at all; (2) data/baskets/snapshots/2026-08-13.json's gold_miners member list also still carries GOLD (with a rationale string mislabeling it 'Barrick Mining') and omits B entirely; (3) the theme_graph builder evidently reads from one of these STALE artifacts rather than the live membership.json, since co:us:GOLD still carries a live MEMBER_OF basket:baskets:gold_miners edge and co:us:B's gold_miners edge, while present, coexists with GOLD's rather than replacing it. Root cause is the snapshot/history regeneration pipeline lagging membership.json's #5632 fix, not membership.json itself -- previously mis-stated as membership.json carrying stale data.

Barrick Gold Corporation renamed to Barrick Mining Corporation and changed its ticker from GOLD to B effective 2025-05-09 (corporate action). B correctly carries the gold_miners membership in the LIVE data/baskets/membership.json (PR #5632 already fixed this). The contradiction lives entirely in DOWNSTREAM artifacts that have not regenerated since the fix: membership_history.parquet, snapshots/2026-08-13.json, and the theme_graph build (see H2/H3 finding for the full chain) -- corrected per adversarial review H2 (previously implied membership.json itself was stale).

curated_baskets_and_ths_receipt_scope_no: curated_baskets (data/baskets/membership.json) and ths_ltheme (data/baskets_china_ths/) carry NO identity-resolution receipt of any kind -- no attempted/refused/dot-dash counters exist for either family in their own metadata. This means any refusal that occurred during their curation (a ticker a curator considered and rejected on identity grounds) is STRUCTURALLY INVISIBLE to this audit -- absence of a recorded refusal is not evidence that none occurred, it is evidence that neither source keeps the kind of receipt that would show one. Only finviz_ltheme has any self-reported resolution telemetry.
